ml-nn-perceptron-07: Pehle check karo ye point mistake hai ya nahi: $y(w\cdot x + b)$ nikaalo. Dhyan do $\eta = 0.5$ hai, 1 nahi.
Mistake ki condition $y\,s \le 0$ hai (zero bhi mistake). Update: $w \leftarrow w + 0.5\cdot y\cdot(1, 3)$, $b \leftarrow b + 0.5\,y$.
Score $s = 2\cdot1 + (-1)\cdot3 + 1$ — ye exactly kitna aata hai? Trap: score 0 ko 'sahi' maan kar update skip kar dena.
ml-nn-perceptron-08: NOR ka matlab: sirf $(0,0)$ par output 1, baaki teen corners par 0. Har option ko chaaron corners par test karo.
Output 1 tab jab $w_1x_1 + w_2x_2 + b > 0$. Har option ke liye scores nikaalo: $(0,0) \to b$, $(0,1) \to w_2 + b$, $(1,0) \to w_1 + b$, $(1,1) \to w_1 + w_2 + b$.
$(-1,-1,1.5)$ ke liye $(0,1)$ par score $-1 + 1.5 = 0.5 > 0$ — to wo NOR nahi ho sakta. Baaki options isi tarah check karo; trap: NAND aur NOR mix karna.
ml-nn-perceptron-09: Sawaal ye hai: kaunsa labelling **linearly separable nahi** hai. Perceptron sirf ek seedhi line khinch sakta hai.
Har option ke $+1$ corners ko ek line se baaki se alag karne ki koshish karo, jaise $x_1 + x_2 = 1.5$, $x_2 = 0.5$, $x_1 + x_2 = 0.5$.
Jis option me same label wale corners diagonal par baithe hain ($(0,0)$ ke saath $(1,1)$), wahan koi line kaam karti hai kya? XOR yaad karo.
ml-nn-perceptron-10: Ek pass kaafi nahi — tab tak chalao jab tak poora pass bina update ke na ho. Point 2 $x = (0,0)$ hai: uska update sirf $b$ badalta hai.
Har point par $s = w\cdot x + b$, mistake agar $y s \le 0$. Phir $w \leftarrow w + yx$, $b \leftarrow b + y$. Har pass ke baad $(w, b)$ likhte jao.
Pass 1: P1 score 0 → $w = (2,1), b = 1$; P2 score $1$, $y = -1$ → mistake, $b = 0$. Aage P3, P4 aur agle passes khud chalao. Trap: pehle pass ke baad ruk jaana.
ml-nn-perceptron-11: MSQ: har statement ko update rule $w + \eta y x$, $b + \eta y$ se seedha check karo. Ek statement $\eta$ scaling ke baare me hai, ek bound ke.
Same point ka naya score: $y((w + \eta y x)\cdot x + b + \eta y)$ expand karo, $y^2 = 1$ use karo. Bound $(R/\gamma)^2$ me kaunse variables hain?
Zero se shuru karke har update $\eta$ ka multiple jodta hai — to $(w, b)$ ka sign pattern $\eta$ par depend karta hai kya? Trap: 'ek update = point hamesha sahi' maan lena.
ml-nn-perceptron-12: Bound $(R/\gamma)^2$ me $w^*$ **unit vector** hona chahiye. $u = (3,4)$ unit nahi hai — pehle normalise karo.
$w^* = u/\lVert u\rVert = (0.6, 0.8)$. $\gamma = \min_i y_i\,w^*\cdot x_i$ aur $R = \max_i \lVert x_i\rVert$ (saare points me se).
Point 2: $y\,w^*\cdot x = -(0.6\cdot(-2) + 0.8\cdot1) = 0.4$. Baaki teen margins aur chaaron norms nikaalo, phir ratio square karo. Trap: square bhool jaana.
ml-nn-forward-07: Layer by layer chalo: pehle $z = W_1x + b_1$ (rows of $W_1$ = units), phir ReLU, phir $v^\top h + c$.
$z_i = (\text{row } i \text{ of } W_1)\cdot(2, -1, 1) + b_{1,i}$. ReLU har negative $z_i$ ko 0 kar deta hai.
Row 1: $2 - 2 - 1 = -1$, plus $b = 0$ → $z_1 = -1$, to $h_1 = 0$. Rows 2, 3 khud karo. Trap: ReLU bhool kar negatives rakh lena.
ml-nn-forward-08: Do ReLU units ko alag-alag socho: kab $x - 1 > 0$ aur kab $-x - 1 > 0$? Teen regions banenge.
Regions: $x > 1$, $-1 \le x \le 1$, $x < -1$. Har region me sirf active unit ka value jodo; ReLU output kabhi negative nahi.
$x = 0$ par dono pre-activations $-1$ hain, to $f(0) = 0$. Ab $x = 3$ aur $x = -3$ try karke options match karo. Trap: $|x| - 1$ jo beech me negative ho jaata hai.
ml-nn-forward-09: Teen stages: sigmoid layer, phir ReLU layer, phir linear output. $\ln 3$ wala bias dekh kar $\sigma(\ln 3)$ ki value carefully nikaalni hai.
$z = Wx + b$, $h = \sigma(z)$ jahan $\sigma(\ln 3) = 1/(1 + e^{-\ln 3}) = 1/(1 + 1/3)$. Phir $a = \mathrm{ReLU}(Uh + c)$.
$Wx = (2 - 2, 1 - 1) = (0, 0)$, to $z = (0, \ln 3)$ aur $h_1 = 0.5$. Ab $h_2$, phir $Uh + c$ nikaalo. Trap: $e^{-\ln 3}$ ko 3 lena.
ml-nn-forward-10: MSQ: har statement alag property hai — tanh–sigmoid relation, softmax vs sigmoid, ReLU scaling, aur output ka sign.
$\sigma(2z) = 1/(1 + e^{-2z})$ se $2\sigma(2z) - 1$ simplify karo. ReLU ke liye: $c > 0$ par $\mathrm{ReLU}(cz) = c\,\mathrm{ReLU}(z)$.
Sigmoid units ek doosre ko dekhte hi nahi — to sum 1 kaise force hoga? Output weight negative ho to $\hat y$ ka sign kya ho sakta hai?
ml-nn-forward-11: Row $i$ of $W$ = unit $i$. Order: $Wx$, phir $+b$, phir ReLU — teeno steps chahiye.
$z_1 = (1, 3)\cdot(2, 1) + b_1$, $z_2 = (2, -1)\cdot(2, 1) + b_2$. Phir har negative ko 0.
$Wx$ ka pehla entry $2 + 3 = 5$; $b_1 = -6$ jodo. Ab doosra unit khud karo. Trap: columns ko units maan lena ($W^\top x$).
ml-nn-forward-12: Teen stages: ReLU hidden, linear logits, phir **softmax** (teeno logits par ek saath), sigmoid nahi.
$W_1x = (1 + 1, -1 - 1) = (2, -2)$; $b_1$ jodo aur ReLU lagao, phir $Uh + c$. Trap: hidden ReLU skip karna, ya sirf $\sigma(z_1)$ lena.
ml-nn-params-06: Teen dense layers hain: $20\to32$, $32\to32$, $32\to1$. Input layer ke koi parameters nahi; har hidden aur output unit ka ek bias.
Har layer: $n_{in}\cdot n_{out} + n_{out}$. Teeno layers ka alag-alag nikaal ke jodo.
Layer 1: $20\cdot32 + 32 = 672$. Ab $32\to32$ aur $32\to1$ khud karo. Trap: output unit ka akela bias bhool jaana.
ml-nn-params-07: Dhyan: **no biases anywhere**. Sirf connections (weights) ginne hain, units nahi.
Weights $= \sum n_{in}\cdot n_{out}$ over layers: $3\cdot4$ plus $4\cdot2$.
Pehli layer $3\cdot4 = 12$ weights. Doosri layer jodo. Trap: teeno sizes multiply kar dena ($3\cdot4\cdot2$) ya biases jod dena.
ml-nn-params-08: Ulta sawaal: total diya hai, input size $d$ dhoondhna hai. Pehle total ko $d$ ke formula me likho.
Output layer $17\cdot4 = 68$, hidden layer $16d + 16$. To $16d + 84 = 500$ — ab solve karo. Trap: 16 hidden biases bhool jaana.
ml-nn-params-09: MSQ: har statement ko shape rule se check karo — $W^{(l)}$ ka shape $n_l \times n_{l-1}$, aur har hidden/output unit ka ek bias.
Layers: $12\to8$, $8\to6$, $6\to3$. Teesri layer: weights $6\cdot3$ plus biases 3. Biases total: har non-input unit ka ek.
$W^{(2)}$: output 6 units, input 8 — rows kaun, columns kaun? Input layer ke 12 numbers data hain ya parameters? Trap: layer count me biases chhodna.
ml-nn-params-10: Do designs ke parameter count compare karne hain: purani ek layer vs nayi do layers (bottleneck 10). Biases dono me hain.
Purani: $100\cdot50 + 50$. Nayi: $(100\cdot10 + 10) + (10\cdot50 + 50)$. Saving = purani minus nayi.
Purani layer $5050$. Nayi pehli layer $1010$ — ab doosri layer jodo, phir subtract karo. Trap: sirf weights compare karna, ya doosri nayi layer bhool jaana.
ml-nn-params-11: Logistic regression = ek dense layer $30 \to 1$ with sigmoid. Binary hai, to output unit sirf ek.
Weights $30\cdot1$; ab output unit ka bias jodo. Trap: bias $b$ bhool jaana, ya ise 2-output softmax samajhna.
ml-nn-params-12: Network $10 \to 20 \to \dots \to 20 \to 1$, jisme $L$ hidden layers. Pehli hidden layer baaki hidden layers se alag count deti hai.
Pehli hidden: $10\cdot20 + 20$. Har agli hidden: $20\cdot20 + 20$. Output: $20 + 1$. Total $= 220 + 420(L - 1) + 21$.
$220 + 21 = 241$, to $420(L - 1) = 1501 - 241 = 1260$. Ab $L - 1$ nikaalo aur $L$ tak jao. Trap: $L - 1$ ko hi answer likh dena.
ml-nn-backprop-07: $w_2$ output layer ka weight hai — iska gradient bas output error times hidden value hai. Loss me $\tfrac12$ hai.
$\partial L/\partial w_2 = (\hat y - y)\cdot h$, jahan $h = \mathrm{ReLU}(w_1x + b_1)$.
$z = 2\cdot2 - 1 = 3$, to $h = 3$ aur $\hat y = w_2 h = 3$. Ab $(\hat y - y)$ aur $h$ multiply karo. Trap: $y - \hat y$ lena (sign ulta).
ml-nn-backprop-08: Gradient ka shape hamesha parameter jaisa hota hai. $W$ ka shape kya hai jab $a \in \mathbb{R}^4$ aur $z \in \mathbb{R}^3$?
$z_i = \sum_j W_{ij}a_j + b_i$, to $\partial L/\partial W_{ij} = \delta_i\,a_j$. Ise matrix form me likho.
$W$ $3\times4$ hai, to gradient bhi $3\times4$. $\delta a^\top$ aur $a\delta^\top$ ke shapes compare karo. Trap: $\partial L/\partial b = \delta$ ko weight gradient maan lena.
ml-nn-backprop-09: $W_{21}$ = unit 2, input 1. Index order dhyan se padho: pehla index unit ($\delta$), doosra input ($a$).
$\delta_2 = -2$, $a_1 = 3$ — ab multiply karo, sign ke saath. Trap: $\delta_1 a_2$ le lena (indices swap).
ml-nn-backprop-10: Hidden layer ka $\delta$ chahiye: output $\delta^{(2)}$ ko $W_2^\top$ se peeche bhejo, phir ReLU gate lagao. $z^{(1)}$ ke signs se gate milta hai.
$W_2^\top\delta^{(2)}$ ka entry 2 = column 2 of $W_2$ dot $(1, -2)$ = $1\cdot1 + 3\cdot(-2)$. Unit 2 active hai ($z = 0.5$); ab $x_1$ se multiply karo. Trap: $x_1$ bhool jaana.
ml-nn-backprop-11: Chain rule: $\partial L/\partial z = \partial L/\partial h \cdot \dfrac{dh}{dz}$. Sawaal sirf $\sigma$ ke derivative ka hai.
$\sigma(z) = 1/(1 + e^{-z})$ ko differentiate karo aur result ko $\sigma$ ke terms me likho.
$\dfrac{d}{dz}(1 + e^{-z})^{-1} = e^{-z}/(1 + e^{-z})^2$. Ise $\sigma\cdot(\dots)$ ke form me todo. Trap: tanh ka $1 - \tanh^2$ ya ReLU ka 0/1 gate le lena.
ml-nn-backprop-12: MSQ: chaaron statements gradient flow ke baare me — backprop ki cost, tanh vs sigmoid derivative, sigmoid chain, aur active ReLU.
$\sigma'(z) \le 0.25$, $\tanh'(z) = 1 - \tanh^2 z \le 1$, $\mathrm{ReLU}'(z) = 1$ for $z > 0$. Har layer gradient ko $w\cdot\phi'(z)$ se multiply karti hai.
Chain me 10 units: kitne $\sigma'$ factors aate hain, aur har ek kitna bada ho sakta hai? Backprop ek hi backward pass me saare $\delta$ reuse karta hai ya nahi — socho.
ml-nn-backprop-13: Scalar chain: $L \to \hat y \to h \to z \to w_1$. Hidden unit sigmoid hai, to beech me $\sigma'(z)$ aayega.
$\partial L/\partial w_1 = (\hat y - y)\cdot w_2\cdot \sigma'(z)\cdot x$, jahan $\sigma'(z) = \sigma(z)(1 - \sigma(z))$.
$z = 1\cdot2 - 2 = 0$, to $\sigma(0) = 0.5$ aur $\hat y = 4\cdot0.5 + 1 = 3$. Ab $\sigma'(0)$ nikaal ke chain multiply karo. Trap: $\sigma'$ ki jagah $\sigma$ lena.
ml-nn-backprop-14: Do ReLU layers aur sigmoid + cross-entropy output. Pehle forward chalao taaki dono ReLU gates aur $p$ pata chalein.
Sigmoid + CE: $\partial L/\partial z = p - y$. Phir $\partial L/\partial w = (p - y)\cdot v\cdot \mathrm{gate}_2\cdot u\cdot \mathrm{gate}_1\cdot x$.

$h_1 = \mathrm{ReLU}(2 - 1) = 1$, $h_2 = \mathrm{ReLU}(-1 + 3) = 2$, output $z = 2 - 2 = 0$, to $p = \sigma(0)$. Ab chain multiply karo. Trap: $\sigma'$ dobara multiply karna, ya $u = -1$ ka sign khona.
ml-nn-backprop-15: Unit 2 ka $z_2 < 0$, to $h_2 = 0$ aur ReLU gate 0. Socho kaunse parameters is unit se **ho kar** guzarte hain — andar aane wale bhi, bahar jaane wala bhi.

Incoming: $\partial L/\partial W_{2j} = \delta_2 x_j$, $\partial L/\partial b_2 = \delta_2$, jahan $\delta_2 = v_2(\hat y - y)\cdot\mathrm{ReLU}'(z_2)$. Outgoing: $\partial L/\partial v_2 = (\hat y - y)\,h_2$.
$\mathrm{ReLU}'(z_2) = 0$, to $\delta_2$ kya hoga? Aur $h_2 = 0$ hone se $v_2$ ka gradient? Trap: sirf ek side (incoming ya outgoing) dekhna.
ml-nn-backprop-16: MSQ: har option ek single entry hai. Rule yaad karo: weight gradient $= \delta_i\,a_j$, bias gradient $= \delta_i$.
$\partial L/\partial W = \delta a^\top$ with $\delta = (2, -1)$, $a = (3, 0)$. Bias ke liye $\partial z_i/\partial b_i = 1$.
$W_{11}$: $\delta_1 a_1 = 2\cdot3$ — option se compare karo. Baaki entries isi tarah, sign ke saath. Trap: input $a_j$ se multiply bhool jaana.
ml-nn-sgd-07: Sirf bias ka update chahiye. Pehle forward pass me $\hat y$ nikaalo — bias $b = 1$ ko bhi jodna hai.
$\tfrac12$ wale loss me $\partial L/\partial b = \hat y - y$. Update: $b \leftarrow b - 0.25\,(\hat y - y)$.
$\hat y = 0.5\cdot2 + 2\cdot(-1) + 1$ nikaalo, phir $\hat y - (-2)$. Trap: minus ki jagah plus (ascent) ya factor 2 lagana.
ml-nn-sgd-08: Gradient descent: gradient ki **ulti** direction me chalna hai, har component apne sign ke saath.
$0.1\cdot(3, -2) = (0.3, -0.2)$. Ab $(1,1)$ me se subtract karo — negative ko subtract karna = add. Trap: $\eta$ bhool jaana.
ml-nn-sgd-09: Logistic + cross-entropy ka shortcut: $\partial L/\partial z = p - y$. Yahan $w \ne 0$, to pehle $z$ aur $p$ nikaalne padenge.
$\partial L/\partial w_1 = (p - y)\,x_1$ aur $w_1 \leftarrow w_1 - 0.5\,(p - y)\,x_1$, jahan $p = \sigma(w^\top x + b)$.
$z = 1\cdot2 + (-1)\cdot1 = 1$, to $p = \sigma(1) = 1/(1 + e^{-1})$. Ab $p - 0$ ko $x_1 = 2$ se multiply karke step lo. Trap: $\sigma'$ dobara multiply karna.
ml-nn-sgd-10: MSQ: mini-batch SGD ke chaar facts — gradient of mean, kis data par update, epoch me updates, aur batch size ka step par asar.
Mean loss $\frac1B\sum L_i$ ka gradient linear hota hai. Ek epoch me har batch par ek update hota hai: updates $= N/B$.
$N/B = 1000/50$ khud check karo. Mean loss me $B$ double karne se gradient ka scale badalta hai kya? Trap: SGD ko full-batch GD samajhna.
ml-nn-sgd-11: Softmax + cross-entropy: $\partial L/\partial z_k = p_k - y_k$. Class 2 true class nahi hai, to $y_2 = 0$.
Denominator $4 + 3 + 1 = 8$. Ab $p_2$ nikaalo aur $y_2$ subtract karo. Trap: class 2 ko true class maan kar $p_2 - 1$ lena.
ml-nn-sgd-12: Softmax output layer ka ek weight update. $W = 0$ se shuru hai, to saare logits barabar — probabilities easy hain.
$\partial L/\partial W_{kj} = (p_k - y_k)\,h_j$, aur $W_{32} \leftarrow W_{32} - 0.3\,(p_3 - y_3)\,h_2$.
Logits $(0, 0, 0)$, to har $p_k = 1/3$. True class 3, to $p_3 - y_3 = 1/3 - 1$. Ab $h_2$ aur $\eta$ lagao. Trap: $h_1$ le lena.
ml-nn-sgd-13: Label $y = 0$ hai lekin $z = 12$ bahut bada — model confident aur galat hai. Loss cross-entropy hai, squared error nahi.
Sigmoid + CE: $\partial L/\partial z = p - y$, jahan $p = \sigma(12)$.
$\sigma(12) = 1/(1 + e^{-12})$ — ye 0 ke paas hai ya 1 ke? Trap: saturation ki wajah se gradient zero maan lena (wo SE me hota hai).
ml-nn-sgd-14: Plain SGD: har example ke **baad** $w$ update hota hai, to doosre example ka gradient naye $w$ par nikalta hai.
Har step: gradient $= (wx - y)\,x$ (½ wala loss), phir $w \leftarrow w - 0.1\cdot\text{gradient}$.
Step 1 at $w = 0$: gradient $(0 - 2)\cdot1 = -2$, to $w = 0.2$. Ab $w = 0.2$ par example $(2, 1)$ karo. Trap: dono gradients $w = 0$ par hi nikaalna.
ml-nn-sgd-15: Dhyan: sigmoid output ke saath **squared error**, aur ½ nahi hai. CE wala shortcut $p - y$ yahan nahi chalega.
$\partial L/\partial w = 2(p - y)\cdot p(1 - p)\cdot x$, aur $w \leftarrow w - \eta\,\partial L/\partial w$.
$w = 0$ par $z = 0$, $p = \sigma(0)$ aur $\sigma'(0) = 0.25$. Ab chaaron factors multiply karke step lo. Trap: factor 2 chhodna, ya plus karna.
ml-nn-sgd-16: MSQ: har statement ko update $w - \eta\nabla L$ se seedha check karo — sign, step ka size, aur linear model ka gradient.
Step vector $= -\eta\nabla L$, length $= \eta\lVert\nabla L\rVert$. Linear model: $\partial/\partial w$ of $\tfrac12(w^\top x - y)^2$ chain rule se nikaalo.
Gradient double ho jaaye aur $\eta$ same rahe to step chhota hoga ya bada? Aur 'loss increase' kya descent ka goal hai? Trap: ascent vs descent mix karna.
